_comment: See game/godot/Audio/SPEC.md for the human-readable workflow. Each entry is a SLOT (the semantic concept, e.g. 'ui_click'). Inside the slot, 'approved' holds the single variant that ships; 'variants' is the review queue of freshly generated alternatives that the human can listen to, approve or deprecate.

globalMusicAnchor.instruments: warm analog synth pads, electric piano (Rhodes), pizzicato strings, soft brushed snare, no drums on menu tracks
globalMusicAnchor.palette: warm 1990s synthwave — muted oranges, deep blues, soft creams. No bright leads, no distorted guitars.
transitionRules: Every track MUST begin and end on the C major tonic chord (C-E-G) so any two tracks can be crossfaded without harmonic clash.
Every track MUST contain a 4-bar bridge at the loop point whose chord progression resolves back to C major, enabling seamless A→B or B→A transitions.
No track introduces chromatic notes, modulations outside the C major scale, or borrowed chords.
No track uses percussion beyond a soft brushed snare — drums belong only to the matchday stingers, which are short non-looping accents.

groups.styleAnchor: Retro 1990s PC speaker UI sound. Short, crisp, synthesized, dry. Should sound like they all came from the same sound chip.

entries.prompt: soft UI click — short and dry, like a finger tapping a membrane keyboard
subtle hover tick — even shorter than the click, almost subliminal
positive confirmation — a short two-note ascending chirp
negative cancel — a short two-note descending chirp
error buzz — short buzzy reject tone
incoming notification — soft bell-like ping, ~250ms

groups.styleAnchor: Retro 1990s football management PC game stadium sound effects. Should sound lo-fi but unmistakable — they are what the manager hears from the stands.

entries.prompt: referee short whistle — single sharp blast, ~600ms
referee long whistle — sustained blast, ~1.5 seconds
penalty award whistle — three short sharp blasts in quick succession
stadium crowd short cheer — quick roar that decays in ~2 seconds
stadium crowd disappointed groan — short communal 'ohhh', ~1.5 seconds
stadium crowd rhythmic clapping chant — repeated claps with low vocal roar, ~3 seconds
football kick impact — leather thud with a touch of boot-on-ball squeak
football bouncing on grass — two quick soft bounces
ball hitting the goalpost — sharp metallic clang

groups.styleAnchor: Section navigation in the workspace sidebar (Overview / Squad / Tactics / Competitions / Market / Finances / World). Should feel cohesive with sfx.ui but slightly more deliberate — these are larger transitions.

entries.prompt: workspace sidebar section change — short sweeping whoosh with soft tap, ~400ms
workspace sidebar button hover — subtle wood-block tick, very short, almost subliminal
workspace sidebar button pinned / focused — soft positive two-note ping

groups.styleAnchor: Pack editor — placing, rotating and removing tiles / cards / stickers on the canvas. Crispy, satisfying, retro-gamey.

entries.prompt: pack editor tile placed — chunky satisfying snap, like a stamp hitting paper, ~150ms
pack editor tile removed — soft click-pop, like a suction cup detaching, ~120ms
pack editor tile rotated — quick wooden tick, very short, ~80ms
pack editor canvas saved — ascending two-note confirmation, slightly brighter than ui_confirm, ~300ms

groups.styleAnchor: Extended match commentary stingers: cards, fouls, shots, saves, substitutions. Each event needs a short, identifiable sting that the manager associates with that exact play.

entries.prompt: match kickoff stinger — single short whistle followed by a quick crowd swell, ~1 second
half time whistle — two long sustained blasts, ~1.5 seconds
yellow card sting — single sharp whistle beep plus a short plastic card flick, ~800ms
red card sting — sharp whistle plus a louder plastic card flick with a low ominous tone underneath, ~1 second
foul whistle — single medium whistle with a short crowd ohh, ~700ms
shot on target — leather strike followed by a glove save slap, ~1 second
shot off target — leather strike followed by a thud against advertising board, ~1 second
substitution sting — board-up electronic ping plus short crowd murmur, ~900ms

groups.styleAnchor: Transfer market stingers — incoming offer, scout report, completed deal. Lo-fi retro chime-ish to fit the 1990s chip aesthetic but with a cash-register undertone for deals.

entries.prompt: transfer offer received — soft incoming message chime, ~400ms
scout report delivered — paper unfolding rustle plus a soft bell ping, ~600ms
transfer deal complete — vintage cash register ka-ching plus a short crowd cheer, ~1.2 seconds
transfer offer rejected — soft descending two-note decline, ~300ms

groups.styleAnchor: Career achievement stingers — manager of the month, season complete, promotion, relegation, trophy lift. Each is a short fanfare that complements music.trophy.trophy_lift without overshadowing it.

entries.prompt: manager of the month sting — short three-note ascending brass-like fanfare, ~1.2 seconds
season complete sting — soft bell sequence (ding-ding-ding) with a crowd swell, ~1.5 seconds
promotion sting — bright ascending brass fanfare with crowd roar, ~2 seconds
relegation sting — soft descending minor-ish chime plus a quiet crowd groan, ~1.5 seconds
